'''Maalva''' was the [[King/Legends|king]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] following the [[Showdown at Toydaria/Legends|death]] of his uncle, [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]]. Maalva was a harsh [[Monarchy/Legends|ruler]] who would pit his subjects against each other in the [[Toydarian seasonal wars]] for his own gain. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], Maalva sold [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarians]] from remote villages into [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].

==Biography==
[[File:KatuunkoPresiding-SL.png|thumb|right|275px|Maalva became king of Toydaria after the assassination of his uncle, Katuunko (pictured).]]
Maalva was the [[Gender/Legends|nephew]] of<ref name="Lords" /> the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]]<ref name="Witches">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref> [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]], who was [[King/Legends|king]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Following Katuunko's [[Showdown at Toydaria/Legends|assassination]]<ref name="Lords" /> by the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]<ref name="Witches" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="TCW date">{{TCWdates|314}}</ref> Maalva succeeded him as [[Monarchy/Legends|king]]. Maalva maintained his power by recruiting ambitious vassals who were loyal to him. During the [[Toydarian seasonal wars]]<ref name="Lords" />&mdash;a cycle of violence driven by changes in Toydaria's climate approximately once every three [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]<ref name="Characters">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>&mdash;Maalva neglected his royal responsibility to resolve the conflicts. Instead, he allowed the rival Toydarian factions to deal with matters on their own, and would occasionally incite conflicts in order to solidify his own power. Maalva's harsh rule also made Toydarian [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] wary of outsiders.<ref name="Lords" />

Toydaria left the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] following Katuunko's [[Death/Legends|death]]. After<ref name="Lords" /> the Republic [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Maalva tolerated the Imperial presence on Toydaria by the order of his [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] overlords. King Maalva profited during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] by ordering the abduction of Toydarian villagers in remote settlements and selling them into Imperial [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. The king was paid substantially in the deal, and [[Starship/Legends|starships]] bearing his royal seal were exempt from customs inspections. His dealings were kept secret from his own councilors.<ref name="Lords" />

==Personality and traits==
Maalva was a cantankerous, conniving, and petty braggart, in contrast to his uncle's mild temperament. He ruled harshly and was politically savvy enough to incite conflicts among his servants to secure his own power. He was willing to profit from the enslavement of Toydarians and kept his arrangements hidden from members of his council. While benefiting from his own scheming, Maalva would blame Toydaria's seeming lack of prosperity on the Empire, the Hutts, or on a bad roll of a [[Chance cube/Legends|chance cube]].<ref name="Lords" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maalva was mentioned in ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', a [[2015]] sourcebook for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]].<ref name="Lords" />
